args.description: from lying on his back, swings a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged low across in front of him, then low behind him while springing to his feet, ending in the ready stance. The whole weapon stays inside the picture. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture.
args.subject_description: a young man with spiky black hair streaked with red, red eyes, a long red scarf, an open black and red coat over a bare chest, black trousers, red and black boots, holding a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged
args.initial_pose: lying on his back on the ground
